{{Youmay|the creature native to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]|the [[Flailer (vehicle)|agricultural vehicle]]}}
'''Flailers''' were floating sanguivores native to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Round and flat, measuring about 2 meters across, they inhabited the surface layer of the planet's southern ocean. Their skin was jet black and shiny, being easily mistaken for [[Oil/Legends|oil]] slicks. Tiny, razor-sharp teeth-like appendages ring the edge of the flailer's body. It uses these [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] to rake across its prey, ingesting the resultant [[Blood/Legends|blood]] from the water.<ref name="Death">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref>
